description: This file defines the NotesProvider class, a state management class that handles operations related to notes such as creating, updating, deleting, and fetching notes, using a NotesRepository for data persistence.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages the state of notes, including loading, creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving notes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the provider by setting loading to true, fetching notes, and then setting loading to false.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the list of notes from the repository.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title and content, optionally pinned, and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note and refreshes the list.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID and refreshes the list.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID from the in-memory list, returns null if not found.

methods.name: _setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading state and notifies listeners.
